examples.text: Detlef schuftet ohne zu murren von früh bis spät in der Werkstatt, aber Büroarbeit verabscheut er.

examples.text: In fear of disease and in the interest of his health man will be muzzled and masked like a vicious dog, and that without any murmur of complaint.

glosses: To grumble; to complain in a low, muttering voice, or express discontent at or against someone or something.

examples.text: The Iewes then murmured at him because he sayde: I am that breed which is come doune from heaven.

glosses: To speak or make low, indistinguishable noise; to mumble, mutter.

examples.text: I couldn't hear the words; he just murmured a lot.
The bees murmured in the forest. The waves murmured on the shore.

glosses: A low thundering, rumbling or growling sound.
The sound made by a hungry stomach.

examples.text: That whiner is never without a grumble to share.

glosses: To make a low, growling or rumbling noise, like a hungry stomach or certain animals.

examples.text: The distant thunder grumbles.

glosses: To complain; to murmur or mutter with discontent; to make ill-natured complaints in a low voice and a surly manner.

examples.text: He grumbles about the food constantly, but has yet to learn to cook.

glosses: To utter in a grumbling fashion.

examples.text: He grumbled that there was no grain "in the country" and that people were talking instead of working to provide it.

glosses: Faire entendre un murmure, un bruit de voix sourd et confus.

examples.text: Cela n’est pas certain, mais on en murmure.
